scope: Exploratory single-target v2 diagnostic, prospectively frozen before its inference. V2 full propagation is already negative (present Dice 0.6925238080 versus native 0.7190363462); this is not an independent confirmation or a new efficacy method.
question: On an unchanged native SAM2 trajectory, what is the immediate effect of the exact v2 older-boundary pruning policy, compared with count-matched and shape/contiguity-matched spatial controls? Compare with archived full v2 only descriptively; immediate versus accumulated effects have different conditioning banks.
engine: Pinned SAM2.1 Hiera B+, CPU FP32 no autocast, unchanged native memory writer/BF16 storage. Reuse verified Efficient-SAM2 gather/apply_rotary_enc_prune adapter. One first-visible GT mask prompt; subsequent memory labels from own native stored predicted 256 logits. No anatomical or semantic-purity claim.
window: Native prompt plus previous six nonprompt frames; current frame is query only. Prompt and latest spatial memories dense. Older memories retain labels0/1 and exclude mixed boundary label2. Native temporal slots and every native object pointer preserved, including pointers older than the spatial window.
controls: Reuse unchanged author random selector and existing rigid_control without wrap/clipping. Match excluded counts separately per older frame. Protect prompt/latest identically. Rigid null preserves component geometry/perimeter; position and border proximity are not matched. Record overlap/transform/candidate eligibility. Empty/invariant masks remain unchanged; primary rigid contrast requires at least one informative older frame. Seeds averaged within target, never treated as independent samples.
replay: Native propagation only writes memory. Branch from copied pre-target containers and cached target image features. Official _run_single_frame_inference(run_mem_encoder=False); memory encoder patched to raise if invoked. Before and after interventions, exact all-token gathered replay must equal native full-resolution logits. Check exact active-bank/cache contents and parameter fingerprints; no branch output written back. Save every counterfactual binary mask for later boundary metrics.
gate: Complete native seq2/seq3, match every archived native prediction and stored low-resolution hash. All-token native identity at every postprompt target. Run all seven interventions on the six fixed targets twice; predictions and layer receipts bit-identical. Four layers, native chronology/slots/pointers, prompt/latest protection and actual gathered counts checked. Exact restoration and bank/cache hashes; no encoder/writeback; parameter integrity. Full cohort starts only after every check passes and gate summary upload is confirmed.
cohort: All postprompt targets of21 promptable sequences, excluding seq1/seq7. No efficacy-based early stopping. All native replay hashes must match source23. Expected2012 targets; derive/check each sequence from manifest and native archive.
summary: Present-frame Dice primary. Average each control's three seeds within target, then target paired differences within sequence. Sequence is unit; three contrasts regional-native, regional-random, regional-rigid; paired two-sided Wilcoxon and Holm3,10000 whole-sequence bootstrap95 CI. Negative regional-minus-control means pruning harms. No significance/equivalence claim from a nonsignificant result. Rigid contrast restricted to informative targets. Save IoU, boundary F, GT-empty false alarms and fixed per-frame GT area for descriptive analysis; fixed source16 quartiles [0.020346832275390626,0.053846345464355336,0.11534966362847222]. No tuned thresholds or new region definitions.
outputs: Mounted Drive only, including staged inputs/temp/W&B caches. Save source hashes/commit, source archive, complete gate/full cases, selector bits, scores, masks, native identity/restoration receipts, parameter checks and per-sequence archives. Online W&B summary and sequence delivery; stop on failed correctness or delivery. No rerun of completed v2 full propagation.
stopping: Only integrity, resource or delivery failure stops execution. Any correction must be documented/committed before repeating the gate. No tuning from unexpected outcomes. This tests one settled primary rule and cannot replace the historical all-six-definition claim rule.
